children.description:
상록성 교목. 높이 20m. 소지 털이 없다. 잎 어긋나기, 두터우며, 거꿀피침형, 무딘형 또는 첨두, 예저, 크기는 5-12(15)cm × 2-4cm 이다. 양면에 털이 없고 표면은 윤채가 있으며 뒷면은 회녹색, 가장자리에 파상의 톱니가 있다. 잎자루는 1.5-2cm 이다. 꽃 총상꽃차례는 잎이 떨어진 전년지의 잎겨드랑이에서 달리며, 길이 5-10cm, 털이 있다. 꽃은 암수한꽃, 흰색, 꽃받침잎은 넓은피침형 또는 피침형, 길이 3-4mm, 양면에 털이 있다. 꽃잎은 5개, 중앙까지 잘게 젖혀지며, 길이 4-5mm, 연한 노란색, 5개의 선과 20개의 수술이 존재하고 씨방에 융모가 있다. 열매 및 종자 핵과는 타원형, 길이 20-25mm, 흑벽색, 종자는 크고 겉에 주름이 진다.

children.name: Fontainea australis Jessup & Guymer
children.description: Fontainea australis is a rare rainforest plant from eastern Australia.

children.name: Fontainea borealis P.I.Forst.
children.description: Fontainea borealis is a small tree endemic to Papua New Guinea, in the family, Euphorbiaceae, which grows to a height of 12 m.

children.name: Fontainea fugax P.I.Forst.
children.description: Fontainea fugax is a shrub endemic to Queensland, in the family, Euphorbiaceae, growing up to 4 m.

children.name: Fontainea oraria Jessup & Guymer
children.description: Fontainea oraria is a rare rainforest plant growing near the sea on private property near Lennox Head, New South Wales, Australia.

children.name: Fontainea pancheri  Heckel
children.description: Fontainea pancheri is a small tree or shrub endemic to New Caledonia in the family, Euphorbiaceae, which grows to a height of 15 m.

children.name: Fontainea picrosperma C.T.White
children.description: Fontainea picrosperma, commonly known as the blushwood tree, is a rainforest tree in the family Euphorbiaceae endemic to Queensland in Australia, where it grows on the Atherton Tablelands.

children.name: Fontainea rostrata Jessup & Guymer
children.description: Fontainea rostrata, commonly known as Deep Creek fontainea, is a rainforest tree or shrub endemic to Queensland in Australia.

children.name: Fontainea subpapuana P.I.Forst.
children.description: Fontainea subpapuana is a small tree endemic to Papua New Guinea in the family, Euphorbiaceae, which grows to a height of 7 m.

children.name: Fontainea venosa Jessup & Guymer
children.description: Fontainea venosa, also commonly known as southern blushwood, veiny fontainea, Queensland fontainea and formerly named as Bahrs scrub fontainea is a rare rainforest shrub or tree of the family Euphorbiaceae.
